_comment: Expected compiled code hash per contract. A rebuild producing a different hash than what's pinned here means a shared file (constants.tolk, common.tolk, stdlib) changed underneath a contract whose own source didn't move -- which silently shifts its deploy address. checkPinnedHashes.ts fails loudly on any mismatch; update the pin deliberately (and re-verify any address that depends on it) rather than silencing the check. See the commit that added this for the incident that motivated it -- LiquidityLocker's documented mainnet address didn't match what its current source actually compiles to.
